"''Ooh, I like this already.|[[Phee Genoa]] and [[Crosshair]]|}} '''Erebus''' was a [[planet]] located in the [[Erebus system]] in the [[Colonies]]. A [[mountain]]ous and muddy world, Erebus had valuable resources that would be extracted by [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] strip mining, which left the terrain even more barren and potholed.{{Databank|erebus|Erebus}} Erebus housed an [[Imperial labor camp]] which utilized [[prisoner]]s for their mining operations. During or after [[18 BBY]],{{TBBDate|312}} [[Clone Force 99]] landed on Erebus to infiltrate the labor camp and [[Rescue of Edmon Rampart|extract]] former [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]] in order to acquire the coordinates of [[Tantiss Base]] from him. {{Planet-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{TBB|Juggernaut (episode)}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|WnmhtnM0hHE|Star Wars: The Bad Batch Final Season | 'Juggernaut' Official Clip}} *{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/juggernaut-episode-guide|text="Juggernaut" Episode Guide | Star Wars: The Bad Batch}} *{{SW|url=news/bad-batch-declassified-juggernaut|text=''Bad Batch'' Declassified: 5 Highlights from "Juggernaut"}} *{{SWYouTube|lJbmQTT-UBI|Star Wars: The Bad Batch Final Season | 'Juggernaut' Official Clip}} *''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' {{MapPoint}} *{{StarWarsGalaxyMap}} {{MapPoint}} *{{Databank|erebus|Erebus}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Erebus}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Erebus |es=Erebus |ja=エレバス |ka=ერებუსი |nl=Erebus }} [[Category:Galactic Empire planets]] [[Category:Planets in the Colonies]]
